topics.title: Write a paragraph about your best vacation.
guiding_questions: When did you have your best vacation?
topics.sample_essay: The best vacation I had was two years ago. I went to Lattakia with my family. We visited many beautiful places, including the blue beach and Ras Al Ashmra. The scenery was amazing. We met wonderful people and tried delicious food. I also bought some nice souvenirs. It was truly an unforgettable experience.

topics.title: Write a paragraph to invite your friends to a one-week holiday.
guiding_questions: Where are you going to spend your holiday?
What activities are you going to do?
What things do you need to take with you?
When are you going to start your holiday?
topics.sample_essay: I am writing to invite you to join me on a one-week holiday. We are going to spend it in Tartous. We will swim in the sea, visit historical sites, and enjoy fresh seafood. You need to bring your swimming suit, sunscreen, and comfortable clothes. We will start on the first of July. I hope you can come.
